title: NNSA recurring qualified rate receives actor- and domain-separated threshold authorization
summary: A contract-specific three-of-five release policy binds each share to the exact release digest, named role, distinct actor, and independent authority domain; same-actor or same-domain quorum construction fails closed and authorization never publishes automatically. Denominator: One threshold schema, twenty-five adversarial cases, seven bounded valid routes, eighteen explicit rejections, and zero production threshold shares or release authorizations issued.
key_findings: Evidence stage: M-of-N threshold release-authorization controls.
